name: Pisac Town Center and Plaza
description: The compact core around the main plaza and the famous artisan market, where most cafes, guesthouses and shops sit within a few walkable blocks. It is lively and convenient, buzzing on market days and calmer in between, and puts you closest to daily life and food.
bestFor: First-time visitors and social nomads who want everything on foot
pros: Everything walkable, from market to cafes
Best food and coffee options nearby
Easy access to colectivos and taxis
cons: Crowded and noisy on market days

name: Hillside Toward the Pisac Ruins
description: The residential streets and rentals climbing the hillside toward the Inca archaeological site, with eco-lodges and casitas favoured by the wellness crowd. Expect stunning terrace and valley views, a peaceful setting and a steeper walk home, plus a real taste of the altitude on every uphill.
bestFor: Retreat-goers and slow travellers seeking calm and views
pros: Close to trails up to the ruins

name: Riverside Toward Calca
description: The flatter area along the Vilcanota river and the road heading toward Calca, mixing local homes with quieter rentals and easy valley access. It trades market-square buzz for space, gardens and simple transport links, making it a practical, low-key base a short ride from the center.
bestFor: Longer stays wanting quiet and lower rents
pros: Quick colectivo links along the valley
cons: A little removed from the town core

name: Urubamba and Ollantaytambo (Sacred Valley Bases)
description: Two larger Sacred Valley towns within roughly an hour of Pisac. Urubamba offers more services, supermarkets and amenities as a valley hub, while Ollantaytambo pairs its own dramatic ruins with the train station toward Machu Picchu, making either a strong alternative or complement to a Pisac stay.
bestFor: Nomads wanting more amenities or a Machu Picchu launch point
pros: More services and supermarkets in Urubamba
Ollantaytambo has the Machu Picchu train
Central for exploring the whole valley
cons: Not Pisac itself, so about an hour away
